findings.message: Acceptance criterion 8 requires `tests/unit/test_key_scope.py` to check that the journal `run_seq` stays the integer `<seq>` in both the scoped and unscoped `Driver.run` calls. `test_driver_scoped_effect_and_integer_sequence` only checks the `effect_completion` keys. It never reads the `run_seq` field on the journaled stage events (`Driver._run` passes `run_seq=seq` to `self.stage(...)`). A change that put `key_seq` into the journal would still pass this test.
findings.paved_road: After `asyncio.run(run())`, read the journal events for the two stage runs that carry `run_seq` and assert that each one is the int `0` (`type(...) is int` and `== 0`), not `"sup-0"`.
